source_units.text: The word of God that came upon Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests, who lived in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
source_units.display_text: The word of God that came upon Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests, who lived in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,

source_units.text: which became God’s word to him in the days of Josiah son of Amos, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
source_units.display_text: which became God’s word to him in the days of Josiah son of Amos, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

source_units.text: It also came in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah, until Jerusalem’s captivity in the fifth month.
source_units.display_text: It also came in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah, until Jerusalem’s captivity in the fifth month.

source_units.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
source_units.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

source_units.text: Before I formed you in the belly, I know you; before you came out of the womb, I have consecrated you. I have appointed you a prophet to nations.
source_units.display_text: Before I formed you in the belly, I know you; before you came out of the womb, I have consecrated you. I have appointed you a prophet to nations.

source_units.text: I said, O Master Lord! Behold, I do not know how to speak, because I am young.
source_units.display_text: I said, O Master Lord! Behold, I do not know how to speak, because I am young.

source_units.text: The Lord said to me, Do not say, I am young, because you will go to everyone to whom I send you, and you will speak according to everything I command you.
source_units.display_text: The Lord said to me, Do not say, I am young, because you will go to everyone to whom I send you, and you will speak according to everything I command you.

source_units.text: Do not fear them, because I am with you to rescue you, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Do not fear them, because I am with you to rescue you, says the Lord.

source_units.text: The Lord stretched out His hand toward me and touched my mouth. The Lord said to me, Behold, I have put My words into your mouth.
source_units.display_text: The Lord stretched out His hand toward me and touched my mouth. The Lord said to me, Behold, I have put My words into your mouth.

source_units.text: Behold, today I have appointed you over nations and kingdoms, to uproot, demolish, destroy, build and plant.
source_units.display_text: Behold, today I have appointed you over nations and kingdoms, to uproot, demolish, destroy, build and plant.

source_units.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying, What do you see, Jeremiah? I said, A nut-wood staff.
source_units.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying, What do you see, Jeremiah? I said, A nut-wood staff.

source_units.text: The Lord said to me, You have seen well, because I am watchful over My words to perform them.
source_units.display_text: The Lord said to me, You have seen well, because I am watchful over My words to perform them.

source_units.text: The Lord’s word came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? I said, A cauldron heated from beneath, its face away from the north.
source_units.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? I said, A cauldron heated from beneath, its face away from the north.

source_units.text: The Lord said to me, From the north calamities will be kindled upon all who inhabit the land.
source_units.display_text: The Lord said to me, From the north calamities will be kindled upon all who inhabit the land.

source_units.text: Because behold, I am summoning all the kingdoms from the north of the land, says the Lord. They will come and each set his throne at the forecourts of Jerusalem’s gates, against all her surrounding walls and against all Judah’s cities.
source_units.display_text: Because behold, I am summoning all the kingdoms from the north of the land, says the Lord. They will come and each set his throne at the forecourts of Jerusalem’s gates, against all her surrounding walls and against all Judah’s cities.

source_units.text: I will speak to them with judgment concerning all their evil, because they abandoned Me, sacrificed to foreign gods and bowed down to the works of their hands.
source_units.display_text: I will speak to them with judgment concerning all their evil, because they abandoned Me, sacrificed to foreign gods and bowed down to the works of their hands.

source_units.text: But you, gird your waist, rise and tell them everything I command you. Do not fear them or be terrified before them, because I am with you to rescue you, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: But you, gird your waist, rise and tell them everything I command you. Do not fear them or be terrified before them, because I am with you to rescue you, says the Lord.

source_units.text: Behold, on this day I have made you like a fortified city and like a strong bronze wall against all Judah’s kings, its rulers and the people of the land,
source_units.display_text: Behold, on this day I have made you like a fortified city and like a strong bronze wall against all Judah’s kings, its rulers and the people of the land,

source_units.text: and they will fight you, but they will certainly not prevail against you, because I am with you to rescue you, said the Lord.
source_units.display_text: and they will fight you, but they will certainly not prevail against you, because I am with you to rescue you, said the Lord.

source_units.text: And He said, Thus says the Lord: I remembered the mercy of your youth and the love of your completion, when you followed the Holy One of Israel, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: And He said, Thus says the Lord: I remembered the mercy of your youth and the love of your completion, when you followed the Holy One of Israel, says the Lord.

source_units.text: Israel is holy. To the Lord he is the first of His produce. All who devour him will offend; calamities will come upon them, declares the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Israel is holy. To the Lord he is the first of His produce. All who devour him will offend; calamities will come upon them, declares the Lord.

source_units.text: Hear the Lord’s word, house of Jacob and every clan of the house of Israel.
source_units.display_text: Hear the Lord’s word, house of Jacob and every clan of the house of Israel.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: What offense did your fathers find in Me, that they withdrew far from Me, followed futile things and became futile?
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: What offense did your fathers find in Me, that they withdrew far from Me, followed futile things and became futile?

source_units.text: They did not say, Where is the Lord who brought us up from Egypt’s land, who guided us in the wilderness, in a boundless and impassable land, a waterless and fruitless land, a land through which nothing passed and where no human being lived?
source_units.display_text: They did not say, Where is the Lord who brought us up from Egypt’s land, who guided us in the wilderness, in a boundless and impassable land, a waterless and fruitless land, a land through which nothing passed and where no human being lived?

source_units.text: I brought you into Carmel to eat its fruits and good things, but you entered and polluted My land and made My inheritance an abomination.
source_units.display_text: I brought you into Carmel to eat its fruits and good things, but you entered and polluted My land and made My inheritance an abomination.

source_units.text: The priests did not say, Where is the Lord? Those holding to the law did not know Me; the shepherds acted ungodly toward Me; the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed what is useless.
source_units.display_text: The priests did not say, Where is the Lord? Those holding to the law did not know Me; the shepherds acted ungodly toward Me; the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed what is useless.

source_units.text: Therefore I will still enter judgment with you, says the Lord, and with your children’s children I will enter judgment.
source_units.display_text: Therefore I will still enter judgment with you, says the Lord, and with your children’s children I will enter judgment.

source_units.text: Cross over to the islands of Kittim and see; send to Kedar and consider carefully. See whether such things have happened.
source_units.display_text: Cross over to the islands of Kittim and see; send to Kedar and consider carefully. See whether such things have happened.

source_units.text: Will nations exchange their gods, though these are not gods? But My people exchanged their glory, from which they will not benefit.
source_units.display_text: Will nations exchange their gods, though these are not gods? But My people exchanged their glory, from which they will not benefit.

source_units.text: Heaven was astonished at this and shuddered exceedingly, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Heaven was astonished at this and shuddered exceedingly, says the Lord.

source_units.text: For My people did two evil things: they abandoned Me, a spring of water of life, and dug broken cisterns for themselves that will not be able to hold water.
source_units.display_text: For My people did two evil things: they abandoned Me, a spring of water of life, and dug broken cisterns for themselves that will not be able to hold water.

source_units.text: Is Israel a slave, or is he house-born? Why has he become spoil?
source_units.display_text: Is Israel a slave, or is he house-born? Why has he become spoil?

source_units.text: Lions roared over him and raised their voice. They made his land a wilderness, and his cities were demolished so that none inhabited them.
source_units.display_text: Lions roared over him and raised their voice. They made his land a wilderness, and his cities were demolished so that none inhabited them.

source_units.text: The sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes knew you and mocked you.
source_units.display_text: The sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes knew you and mocked you.

source_units.text: Has abandoning Me not brought these things upon you? says the Lord your God.
source_units.display_text: Has abandoning Me not brought these things upon you? says the Lord your God.

source_units.text: Now what do you have to do with Egypt’s road, to drink Gihon’s water? And what do you have to do with the Assyrians’ road, to drink river waters?
source_units.display_text: Now what do you have to do with Egypt’s road, to drink Gihon’s water? And what do you have to do with the Assyrians’ road, to drink river waters?

source_units.text: Your apostasy will discipline you, and your evil will rebuke you. Know and see that abandoning Me is bitter for you, says the Lord your God; and I took no pleasure in you, says the Lord your God.
source_units.display_text: Your apostasy will discipline you, and your evil will rebuke you. Know and see that abandoning Me is bitter for you, says the Lord your God; and I took no pleasure in you, says the Lord your God.

source_units.text: For long ago you shattered your yoke and tore apart your bonds, and said, I will not be enslaved, but I will go upon every high hill and beneath every shady tree; there I will abandon myself to my prostitution.
source_units.display_text: For long ago you shattered your yoke and tore apart your bonds, and said, I will not be enslaved, but I will go upon every high hill and beneath every shady tree; there I will abandon myself to my prostitution.

source_units.text: But I planted you as a fruitful vine, wholly genuine. How have you changed into bitterness, you foreign vine?
source_units.display_text: But I planted you as a fruitful vine, wholly genuine. How have you changed into bitterness, you foreign vine?

source_units.text: Even if you wash with natron and multiply cleansing herb for yourself, you remain stained in your injustices before Me, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Even if you wash with natron and multiply cleansing herb for yourself, you remain stained in your injustices before Me, says the Lord.

source_units.text: How will you say, I was not polluted and did not follow Baal? See your ways in the burial ground and know what you did. Late her voice wailed; her ways
source_units.display_text: How will you say, I was not polluted and did not follow Baal? See your ways in the burial ground and know what you did. Late her voice wailed; her ways

source_units.text: she broadened upon wilderness waters. In her soul’s desires she was carried by the wind; she was handed over. Who will turn her back? All who seek her will not toil; in her humiliation they will find her.
source_units.display_text: she broadened upon wilderness waters. In her soul’s desires she was carried by the wind; she was handed over. Who will turn her back? All who seek her will not toil; in her humiliation they will find her.

source_units.text: Turn your foot from a rough road and your throat from thirst. But she said, I will be strong, because she had loved strangers and went after them.
source_units.display_text: Turn your foot from a rough road and your throat from thirst. But she said, I will be strong, because she had loved strangers and went after them.

source_units.text: As a thief is ashamed when caught, so the sons of Israel will be ashamed: they, their kings, their rulers, their priests and their prophets.
source_units.display_text: As a thief is ashamed when caught, so the sons of Israel will be ashamed: they, their kings, their rulers, their priests and their prophets.

source_units.text: They said to wood, You are my father, and to stone, You gave birth to me. They turned their backs toward Me, not their faces; and in the time of their calamities they will say, Rise and save us!
source_units.display_text: They said to wood, You are my father, and to stone, You gave birth to me. They turned their backs toward Me, not their faces; and in the time of their calamities they will say, Rise and save us!

source_units.text: Where are your gods that you made for yourself? Will they rise and save you in the time of your affliction? For your gods were as numerous as your cities, Judah, and according to the number of Jerusalem’s streets they sacrificed to Baal.
source_units.display_text: Where are your gods that you made for yourself? Will they rise and save you in the time of your affliction? For your gods were as numerous as your cities, Judah, and according to the number of Jerusalem’s streets they sacrificed to Baal.

source_units.text: Why do you speak to Me? All of you acted ungodly, and all of you acted lawlessly against Me, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Why do you speak to Me? All of you acted ungodly, and all of you acted lawlessly against Me, says the Lord.

source_units.text: In vain I struck your children; you accepted no discipline. A sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion, and you did not fear.
source_units.display_text: In vain I struck your children; you accepted no discipline. A sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion, and you did not fear.

source_units.text: Hear the Lord’s word. Thus says the Lord: Have I become a wilderness to Israel, or a land left barren? Why did My people say, We will not be ruled, and we will come to Thee no more?
source_units.display_text: Hear the Lord’s word. Thus says the Lord: Have I become a wilderness to Israel, or a land left barren? Why did My people say, We will not be ruled, and we will come to Thee no more?

source_units.text: Will a bride forget her adornment, or a virgin her breastband? Yet My people forgot Me for days beyond counting.
source_units.display_text: Will a bride forget her adornment, or a virgin her breastband? Yet My people forgot Me for days beyond counting.

source_units.text: What good practice will you still pursue in your ways to seek love? Not so; you too acted wickedly to pollute your ways.
source_units.display_text: What good practice will you still pursue in your ways to seek love? Not so; you too acted wickedly to pollute your ways.

source_units.text: Even on your hands was found the blood of innocent lives. I did not find them in break-ins, but at every oak.
source_units.display_text: Even on your hands was found the blood of innocent lives. I did not find them in break-ins, but at every oak.

source_units.text: And you said, I am innocent; let His fury turn away from me. Behold, I enter judgment with you because you say, I did not sin.
source_units.display_text: And you said, I am innocent; let His fury turn away from me. Behold, I enter judgment with you because you say, I did not sin.

source_units.text: Why did you show such contempt by repeating your ways? You will also be put to shame by Egypt, as you were put to shame by Assyria.
source_units.display_text: Why did you show such contempt by repeating your ways? You will also be put to shame by Egypt, as you were put to shame by Assyria.

source_units.text: For from here too you will go out with your hands on your head, because the Lord rejected your hope, and you will not prosper in it.
source_units.display_text: For from here too you will go out with your hands on your head, because the Lord rejected your hope, and you will not prosper in it.

source_units.text: If a man sends his wife away, and she leaves him and becomes another man’s, surely she will not return to him again? Would not that woman be utterly polluted? And you prostituted yourself with many shepherds—and were you returning to Me? says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: If a man sends his wife away, and she leaves him and becomes another man’s, surely she will not return to him again? Would not that woman be utterly polluted? And you prostituted yourself with many shepherds—and were you returning to Me? says the Lord.

source_units.text: Lift your eyes straight ahead and see: where have you not been defiled? You sat for them on the roads like a solitary crow, and polluted the land with your prostitution and your evils.
source_units.display_text: Lift your eyes straight ahead and see: where have you not been defiled? You sat for them on the roads like a solitary crow, and polluted the land with your prostitution and your evils.

source_units.text: You had many shepherds as a stumbling block for yourself. You had a prostitute’s appearance; you were shameless toward everyone.
source_units.display_text: You had many shepherds as a stumbling block for yourself. You had a prostitute’s appearance; you were shameless toward everyone.

source_units.text: Did you not call Me a household, a father and the leader of your virginity?
source_units.display_text: Did you not call Me a household, a father and the leader of your virginity?

source_units.text: Will He remain for ever, or will it be guarded always? Behold, you spoke and did these evil things and were able.
source_units.display_text: Will He remain for ever, or will it be guarded always? Behold, you spoke and did these evil things and were able.

source_units.text: The Lord said to me in the days of King Josiah, You saw what the dwelling of Israel did to Me. They went upon every high mountain and beneath every wooded tree and prostituted themselves there.
source_units.display_text: The Lord said to me in the days of King Josiah, You saw what the dwelling of Israel did to Me. They went upon every high mountain and beneath every wooded tree and prostituted themselves there.

source_units.text: After she prostituted herself in all these ways, I said, Return to Me. But she did not return, and faithless Judah saw her faithlessness.
source_units.display_text: After she prostituted herself in all these ways, I said, Return to Me. But she did not return, and faithless Judah saw her faithlessness.

source_units.text: I saw that, concerning all the things in which the dwelling of Israel was caught committing adultery, I sent her away and gave a certificate of divorce into her hands. Yet faithless Judah did not fear; she too went and prostituted herself.
source_units.display_text: I saw that, concerning all the things in which the dwelling of Israel was caught committing adultery, I sent her away and gave a certificate of divorce into her hands. Yet faithless Judah did not fear; she too went and prostituted herself.

source_units.text: Her prostitution came to be regarded as nothing, and she committed adultery with wood and stone.
source_units.display_text: Her prostitution came to be regarded as nothing, and she committed adultery with wood and stone.

source_units.text: In all these things faithless Judah did not return to Me with her whole heart, but in falsehood.
source_units.display_text: In all these things faithless Judah did not return to Me with her whole heart, but in falsehood.

source_units.text: The Lord said to me, Israel has justified himself in comparison with faithless Judah.
source_units.display_text: The Lord said to me, Israel has justified himself in comparison with faithless Judah.

source_units.text: Go and read these words toward the north: Return to Me, dwelling of Israel, says the Lord. I will not set My face firmly against you, because I am merciful, says the Lord, and I will not be angry with you for ever.
source_units.display_text: Go and read these words toward the north: Return to Me, dwelling of Israel, says the Lord. I will not set My face firmly against you, because I am merciful, says the Lord, and I will not be angry with you for ever.

source_units.text: Only recognize your injustice: you acted ungodly toward the Lord your God and spread your ways to strangers beneath every wooded tree, but you did not obey My voice, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Only recognize your injustice: you acted ungodly toward the Lord your God and spread your ways to strangers beneath every wooded tree, but you did not obey My voice, says the Lord.

source_units.text: Return, children who have withdrawn, says the Lord, because I will rule over you. I will take you, one from a city and two from a clan, and bring you into Zion,
source_units.display_text: Return, children who have withdrawn, says the Lord, because I will rule over you. I will take you, one from a city and two from a clan, and bring you into Zion,

source_units.text: and I will give you shepherds according to My heart, and they will shepherd you, shepherding with knowledge.
source_units.display_text: and I will give you shepherds according to My heart, and they will shepherd you, shepherding with knowledge.

source_units.text: When you multiply and increase upon the land in those days, says the Lord, they will no longer say, The ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel. It will not come to mind, be named or be attended to, and it will not be made again.
source_units.display_text: When you multiply and increase upon the land in those days, says the Lord, they will no longer say, The ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel. It will not come to mind, be named or be attended to, and it will not be made again.

source_units.text: In those days and at that time they will call Jerusalem the Lord’s throne, and all the nations will gather to her. They will no longer follow the thoughts of their evil heart.
source_units.display_text: In those days and at that time they will call Jerusalem the Lord’s throne, and all the nations will gather to her. They will no longer follow the thoughts of their evil heart.

source_units.text: In those days the house of Judah will join the house of Israel, and together they will come from the northern land and from all the regions to the land I gave their fathers as an inheritance.
source_units.display_text: In those days the house of Judah will join the house of Israel, and together they will come from the northern land and from all the regions to the land I gave their fathers as an inheritance.

source_units.text: And I said, May it be, Lord! For I will place you among children and give you a chosen land, an inheritance of God Almighty of nations. I said, You will call Me Father and will not turn away from Me.
source_units.display_text: And I said, May it be, Lord! For I will place you among children and give you a chosen land, an inheritance of God Almighty of nations. I said, You will call Me Father and will not turn away from Me.

source_units.text: But as a woman deals faithlessly with the one living with her, so the house of Israel dealt faithlessly with Me, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: But as a woman deals faithlessly with the one living with her, so the house of Israel dealt faithlessly with Me, says the Lord.

source_units.text: A voice was heard from lips, the weeping and supplication of Israel’s children, because they acted unjustly in their ways and forgot their holy God.
source_units.display_text: A voice was heard from lips, the weeping and supplication of Israel’s children, because they acted unjustly in their ways and forgot their holy God.

source_units.text: Return, returning children, and I will heal your fractures. Behold, we will be Thy servants, because Thou art the Lord our God.
source_units.display_text: Return, returning children, and I will heal your fractures. Behold, we will be Thy servants, because Thou art the Lord our God.

source_units.text: Truly the hills and the power of the mountains were false; but through the Lord our God is Israel’s salvation.
source_units.display_text: Truly the hills and the power of the mountains were false; but through the Lord our God is Israel’s salvation.

source_units.text: Shame consumed our fathers’ labors from our youth: their sheep and calves, their sons and daughters.
source_units.display_text: Shame consumed our fathers’ labors from our youth: their sheep and calves, their sons and daughters.

source_units.text: We lay down in our shame, and our dishonor covered us, because we sinned before our God, we and our fathers, from our youth until this day, and did not obey the voice of the Lord our God.
source_units.display_text: We lay down in our shame, and our dishonor covered us, because we sinned before our God, we and our fathers, from our youth until this day, and did not obey the voice of the Lord our God.

source_units.text: If Israel returns, says the Lord, he will return to Me; if he removes his abominations from his mouth and shows reverence before Me,
source_units.display_text: If Israel returns, says the Lord, he will return to Me; if he removes his abominations from his mouth and shows reverence before Me,

source_units.text: and swears, ‘The Lord lives,’ with truth and in judgment and righteousness, then nations will bless in her, and in Him they will praise God in Jerusalem.
source_units.display_text: and swears, ‘The Lord lives,’ with truth and in judgment and righteousness, then nations will bless in her, and in Him they will praise God in Jerusalem.

source_units.text: For thus says the Lord to the men of Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem: Break up fallow ground for yourselves, and do not sow among thorns.
source_units.display_text: For thus says the Lord to the men of Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem: Break up fallow ground for yourselves, and do not sow among thorns.

source_units.text: Be circumcised to your God, and circumcise your hardness of heart, men of Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem, lest My fury come out like fire and burn, and there be no one to extinguish it because of the evil of your practices.
source_units.display_text: Be circumcised to your God, and circumcise your hardness of heart, men of Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem, lest My fury come out like fire and burn, and there be no one to extinguish it because of the evil of your practices.

source_units.text: Announce in Judah, and let it be heard in Jerusalem; say: Signal with a trumpet over the land, and cry loudly! Say: Gather, and let us enter the walled cities!
source_units.display_text: Announce in Judah, and let it be heard in Jerusalem; say: Signal with a trumpet over the land, and cry loudly! Say: Gather, and let us enter the walled cities!

source_units.text: Take up and flee to Zion; hurry, do not stand still, for I am bringing evils from the north and great crushing.
source_units.display_text: Take up and flee to Zion; hurry, do not stand still, for I am bringing evils from the north and great crushing.

source_units.text: A lion has gone up from his enclosure; destroying nations, he has set out and left his place to make the land a desolation, and cities will be demolished so that they are not inhabited.
source_units.display_text: A lion has gone up from his enclosure; destroying nations, he has set out and left his place to make the land a desolation, and cities will be demolished so that they are not inhabited.

source_units.text: For these things, gird yourselves with sackcloth, beat yourselves in mourning and wail, because the Lord’s fury has not turned away from you.
source_units.display_text: For these things, gird yourselves with sackcloth, beat yourselves in mourning and wail, because the Lord’s fury has not turned away from you.

source_units.text: And it will be on that day, says the Lord: the king’s heart and the rulers’ heart will perish, and the priests will be beside themselves and the prophets astonished.
source_units.display_text: And it will be on that day, says the Lord: the king’s heart and the rulers’ heart will perish, and the priests will be beside themselves and the prophets astonished.

source_units.text: And I said: O Master, Lord, surely Thou hast indeed deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace,’ and behold, the sword has reached to their soul!
source_units.display_text: And I said: O Master, Lord, surely Thou hast indeed deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace,’ and behold, the sword has reached to their soul!

source_units.text: At that time they will say to this people and Jerusalem: A spirit of wandering in the wilderness; the daughter of My people’s way is not toward purity or holiness.
source_units.display_text: At that time they will say to this people and Jerusalem: A spirit of wandering in the wilderness; the daughter of My people’s way is not toward purity or holiness.

source_units.text: A spirit of filling will come to Me; but now I speak judgments against them.
source_units.display_text: A spirit of filling will come to Me; but now I speak judgments against them.

source_units.text: Behold, he will come up like a cloud, and his chariots like a storm; his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, because we suffer misery!
source_units.display_text: Behold, he will come up like a cloud, and his chariots like a storm; his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, because we suffer misery!

source_units.text: Wash your heart clean of evil, Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will the schemes of your troubles exist within you?
source_units.display_text: Wash your heart clean of evil, Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will the schemes of your troubles exist within you?

source_units.text: For the voice of one announcing will come from Dan, and trouble will be heard from Mount Ephraim.
source_units.display_text: For the voice of one announcing will come from Dan, and trouble will be heard from Mount Ephraim.

source_units.text: Remind the nations: Behold, they have come! Announce in Jerusalem: Bands come from a distant land and have raised their voice against the cities of Judah.
source_units.display_text: Remind the nations: Behold, they have come! Announce in Jerusalem: Bands come from a distant land and have raised their voice against the cities of Judah.

source_units.text: Like those guarding a field they came against her all around, because you neglected Me, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Like those guarding a field they came against her all around, because you neglected Me, says the Lord.

source_units.text: Your ways and your practices have done these things to you. This is your evil: it is bitter; it has reached to your heart.
source_units.display_text: Your ways and your practices have done these things to you. This is your evil: it is bitter; it has reached to your heart.

source_units.text: My belly, my belly, I am in pain, and the senses of my heart! My soul rages, my heart is torn; I will not be silent, because my soul heard the sound of a trumpet, a cry of war.
source_units.display_text: My belly, my belly, I am in pain, and the senses of my heart! My soul rages, my heart is torn; I will not be silent, because my soul heard the sound of a trumpet, a cry of war.

source_units.text: It calls out misery and crushing, because the whole land has suffered misery; suddenly the tent has suffered misery, and my tent coverings have been torn apart.
source_units.display_text: It calls out misery and crushing, because the whole land has suffered misery; suddenly the tent has suffered misery, and my tent coverings have been torn apart.

source_units.text: How long will I see people fleeing while hearing the sound of trumpets?
source_units.display_text: How long will I see people fleeing while hearing the sound of trumpets?

source_units.text: For the leaders of My people did not know Me; they are foolish sons and not discerning. They are wise at doing evil, but did not learn to do well.
source_units.display_text: For the leaders of My people did not know Me; they are foolish sons and not discerning. They are wise at doing evil, but did not learn to do well.

source_units.text: I looked upon the earth, and behold, nothing; and into heaven, and its lights were not there.
source_units.display_text: I looked upon the earth, and behold, nothing; and into heaven, and its lights were not there.

source_units.text: I saw the mountains, and they were trembling, and all the hills were being shaken.
source_units.display_text: I saw the mountains, and they were trembling, and all the hills were being shaken.

source_units.text: I looked, and behold, there was no human, and all the birds of heaven were terrified.
source_units.display_text: I looked, and behold, there was no human, and all the birds of heaven were terrified.

source_units.text: I saw, and behold, Carmel was a wilderness, and all the cities were burned with fire before the Lord, and they vanished before His furious anger.
source_units.display_text: I saw, and behold, Carmel was a wilderness, and all the cities were burned with fire before the Lord, and they vanished before His furious anger.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: The whole land will be a wilderness, but I will certainly not make a complete end.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: The whole land will be a wilderness, but I will certainly not make a complete end.

source_units.text: For these things let the earth mourn and let heaven above grow dark, because I have spoken and will not change My mind; I have set Myself in motion and will not turn back from it.
source_units.display_text: For these things let the earth mourn and let heaven above grow dark, because I have spoken and will not change My mind; I have set Myself in motion and will not turn back from it.

source_units.text: At the sound of a horseman and a drawn bow the whole countryside withdrew; they entered caves and hid in groves and climbed onto the rocks. Every city was abandoned; no human dwells in them.
source_units.display_text: At the sound of a horseman and a drawn bow the whole countryside withdrew; they entered caves and hid in groves and climbed onto the rocks. Every city was abandoned; no human dwells in them.

source_units.text: And you, what will you do if you put on scarlet and adorn yourself with golden ornaments, and if you paint your eyes with antimony? Your adornment is in vain; your lovers have rejected you; they seek your soul.
source_units.display_text: And you, what will you do if you put on scarlet and adorn yourself with golden ornaments, and if you paint your eyes with antimony? Your adornment is in vain; your lovers have rejected you; they seek your soul.

source_units.text: For I heard a voice like a woman in labor, your groaning like one giving birth for the first time, the voice of the daughter of Zion. She will grow faint and let her hands fall: Woe to me, because my soul fails over those killed!
source_units.display_text: For I heard a voice like a woman in labor, your groaning like one giving birth for the first time, the voice of the daughter of Zion. She will grow faint and let her hands fall: Woe to me, because my soul fails over those killed!

source_units.text: Run through Jerusalem’s streets and see and learn, and search her squares: if you find a man, if there is one doing justice and seeking faithfulness, then I will be merciful to them, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Run through Jerusalem’s streets and see and learn, and search her squares: if you find a man, if there is one doing justice and seeking faithfulness, then I will be merciful to them, says the Lord.

source_units.text: They say, ‘The Lord lives’; do they not therefore swear on falsehoods?
source_units.display_text: They say, ‘The Lord lives’; do they not therefore swear on falsehoods?

source_units.text: Lord, Thine eyes are toward faithfulness. Thou didst scourge them, and they did not suffer; Thou broughtest them to an end, and they would not accept instruction. They hardened their faces beyond rock and would not return.
source_units.display_text: Lord, Thine eyes are toward faithfulness. Thou didst scourge them, and they did not suffer; Thou broughtest them to an end, and they would not accept instruction. They hardened their faces beyond rock and would not return.

source_units.text: And I said: Perhaps they are poor, because they had no ability, because they did not know the Lord’s way and God’s judgment.
source_units.display_text: And I said: Perhaps they are poor, because they had no ability, because they did not know the Lord’s way and God’s judgment.

source_units.text: I will go to the prosperous and speak to them, for they recognized the Lord’s way and God’s judgment. And behold, with one accord they broke the yoke and tore the bonds.
source_units.display_text: I will go to the prosperous and speak to them, for they recognized the Lord’s way and God’s judgment. And behold, with one accord they broke the yoke and tore the bonds.

source_units.text: Therefore a lion from the woodland struck them, and a wolf destroyed them as far as the houses, and a leopard kept watch over their cities. All who leave them will be hunted, because they multiplied their impieties and grew strong in their turnings away.
source_units.display_text: Therefore a lion from the woodland struck them, and a wolf destroyed them as far as the houses, and a leopard kept watch over their cities. All who leave them will be hunted, because they multiplied their impieties and grew strong in their turnings away.

source_units.text: For which of these things should I be merciful to you? Your sons abandoned Me and swore by those who are not gods. And I fed them fully, and they committed adultery and lodged in prostitutes’ houses.
source_units.display_text: For which of these things should I be merciful to you? Your sons abandoned Me and swore by those who are not gods. And I fed them fully, and they committed adultery and lodged in prostitutes’ houses.

source_units.text: They became horses mad for mares; each neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
source_units.display_text: They became horses mad for mares; each neighed after his neighbor’s wife.

source_units.text: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Or will not My soul take vengeance on such a nation?
source_units.display_text: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Or will not My soul take vengeance on such a nation?

source_units.text: Go up against her battlements and tear them down, but do not make a complete end. Leave her supports, because they belong to the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Go up against her battlements and tear them down, but do not make a complete end. Leave her supports, because they belong to the Lord.

source_units.text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have utterly rejected Me, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have utterly rejected Me, says the Lord.

source_units.text: They lied to their own Lord and said: These things are not so; evils will not come upon us, and we will not see sword or famine.
source_units.display_text: They lied to their own Lord and said: These things are not so; evils will not come upon us, and we will not see sword or famine.

source_units.text: Our prophets became wind, and the Lord’s word was not in them. Thus it will be for them.
source_units.display_text: Our prophets became wind, and the Lord’s word was not in them. Thus it will be for them.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord Almighty: Because you spoke this utterance, behold, I have made My words fire in your mouth, and this people wood, and it will devour them.
source_units.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord Almighty: Because you spoke this utterance, behold, I have made My words fire in your mouth, and this people wood, and it will devour them.

source_units.text: Behold, I am bringing a nation upon you from far away, house of Israel, says the Lord, a nation whose language’s sound you will not understand.
source_units.display_text: Behold, I am bringing a nation upon you from far away, house of Israel, says the Lord, a nation whose language’s sound you will not understand.

source_units.text: All are strong,
source_units.display_text: All are strong,

source_units.text: and they will devour your harvest and your bread, and devour your sons and daughters, and devour your sheep and calves, and devour your vineyards and fig orchards and olive groves; and with a sword they will thresh your fortified cities, in which you have trusted.
source_units.display_text: and they will devour your harvest and your bread, and devour your sons and daughters, and devour your sheep and calves, and devour your vineyards and fig orchards and olive groves; and with a sword they will thresh your fortified cities, in which you have trusted.

source_units.text: And it will be in those days, says the Lord your God: I will certainly not bring you to a complete end.
source_units.display_text: And it will be in those days, says the Lord your God: I will certainly not bring you to a complete end.

source_units.text: And when you say, ‘For what reason has the Lord our God done all these things to us?’ you will say to them: Because you served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve foreigners in a land not yours.
source_units.display_text: And when you say, ‘For what reason has the Lord our God done all these things to us?’ you will say to them: Because you served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve foreigners in a land not yours.

source_units.text: Announce these things to the house of Jacob, and let it be heard in Judah.
source_units.display_text: Announce these things to the house of Jacob, and let it be heard in Judah.

source_units.text: Hear these things now, foolish and senseless people: they have eyes and do not see; they have ears and do not hear.
source_units.display_text: Hear these things now, foolish and senseless people: they have eyes and do not see; they have ears and do not hear.

source_units.text: Will you not fear Me? says the Lord. Or will you not show reverence before Me, who appointed sand as the sea’s boundary, an eternal command it will not cross? It will be stirred and will not prevail, and its waves will roar, and it will not cross it.
source_units.display_text: Will you not fear Me? says the Lord. Or will you not show reverence before Me, who appointed sand as the sea’s boundary, an eternal command it will not cross? It will be stirred and will not prevail, and its waves will roar, and it will not cross it.

source_units.text: But this people acquired an unheeding and disobedient heart, and they turned aside and went away.
source_units.display_text: But this people acquired an unheeding and disobedient heart, and they turned aside and went away.

source_units.text: And they did not say in their heart: Let us fear the Lord our God, who gives us early and late rain at the time of fulfillment of the harvest’s command, and He kept it for us.
source_units.display_text: And they did not say in their heart: Let us fear the Lord our God, who gives us early and late rain at the time of fulfillment of the harvest’s command, and He kept it for us.

source_units.text: Your lawless acts turned these things aside, and your sins removed good things from you.
source_units.display_text: Your lawless acts turned these things aside, and your sins removed good things from you.

source_units.text: For impious people were found among My people, and they set traps to destroy men and were catching them.
source_units.display_text: For impious people were found among My people, and they set traps to destroy men and were catching them.

source_units.text: Like a set trap full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they became great and rich.
source_units.display_text: Like a set trap full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they became great and rich.

source_units.text: And they transgressed judgment; they did not judge an orphan’s case, and they were not judging a widow’s case.
source_units.display_text: And they transgressed judgment; they did not judge an orphan’s case, and they were not judging a widow’s case.

source_units.text: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Or will not My soul take vengeance on such a nation?
source_units.display_text: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Or will not My soul take vengeance on such a nation?

source_units.text: Astonishment and horrifying things happened upon the land:
source_units.display_text: Astonishment and horrifying things happened upon the land:

source_units.text: The prophets prophesy unjust things, and the priests applauded with their hands, and My people loved it so. And what will you do after these things?
source_units.display_text: The prophets prophesy unjust things, and the priests applauded with their hands, and My people loved it so. And what will you do after these things?

source_units.text: Take courage, sons of Benjamin, from within Jerusalem, and signal with a trumpet in Tekoa, and raise a sign above Beth-haccherem, because evils have looked out from the north, and great crushing is taking place,
source_units.display_text: Take courage, sons of Benjamin, from within Jerusalem, and signal with a trumpet in Tekoa, and raise a sign above Beth-haccherem, because evils have looked out from the north, and great crushing is taking place,

source_units.text: and your height will be taken away, daughter of Zion.
source_units.display_text: and your height will be taken away, daughter of Zion.

source_units.text: Shepherds and their flocks will come to her, and they will pitch tents against her all around, and each will shepherd with his own hand.
source_units.display_text: Shepherds and their flocks will come to her, and they will pitch tents against her all around, and each will shepherd with his own hand.

source_units.text: Prepare yourselves for war against her! Rise, and let us go up against her at noon! Woe to us, because the day has declined, because evening’s shadows are failing!
source_units.display_text: Prepare yourselves for war against her! Rise, and let us go up against her at noon! Woe to us, because the day has declined, because evening’s shadows are failing!

source_units.text: Rise, and let us go up in the night and destroy her foundations!
source_units.display_text: Rise, and let us go up in the night and destroy her foundations!

source_units.text: For thus says the Lord: Cut down her trees; pour out a force upon Jerusalem. O false city, all oppression is within her!
source_units.display_text: For thus says the Lord: Cut down her trees; pour out a force upon Jerusalem. O false city, all oppression is within her!

source_units.text: As a cistern cools water, so her evil cools; impiety and misery will be heard in her, continually before her. With pain and scourging
source_units.display_text: As a cistern cools water, so her evil cools; impiety and misery will be heard in her, continually before her. With pain and scourging

source_units.text: you will be instructed, Jerusalem, lest My soul depart from you, lest I make you an impassable land that will not be inhabited.
source_units.display_text: you will be instructed, Jerusalem, lest My soul depart from you, lest I make you an impassable land that will not be inhabited.

source_units.text: For thus says the Lord: Glean, glean Israel’s remnants like a vine; turn back like the grape-gatherer to his basket.
source_units.display_text: For thus says the Lord: Glean, glean Israel’s remnants like a vine; turn back like the grape-gatherer to his basket.

source_units.text: To whom shall I speak and testify, and he will hear? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, and they cannot hear. Behold, the Lord’s utterance became a reproach to them; they certainly will not wish to hear it.
source_units.display_text: To whom shall I speak and testify, and he will hear? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, and they cannot hear. Behold, the Lord’s utterance became a reproach to them; they certainly will not wish to hear it.

source_units.text: And I filled up My fury and held back and did not bring them to an end. I will pour it upon little children outside and upon a gathering of young men together, because man and woman will be seized, the elder with one full of days.
source_units.display_text: And I filled up My fury and held back and did not bring them to an end. I will pour it upon little children outside and upon a gathering of young men together, because man and woman will be seized, the elder with one full of days.

source_units.text: And their houses will be transferred to others, fields and their wives together, because I will stretch out My hand against those dwelling in this land, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: And their houses will be transferred to others, fields and their wives together, because I will stretch out My hand against those dwelling in this land, says the Lord.

source_units.text: For from their small to their great, all have carried out lawless deeds; from priest to false prophet, all have done false things.
source_units.display_text: For from their small to their great, all have carried out lawless deeds; from priest to false prophet, all have done false things.

source_units.text: And they treated My people’s fracture with contempt, saying, ‘Peace, peace’; and where is peace?
source_units.display_text: And they treated My people’s fracture with contempt, saying, ‘Peace, peace’; and where is peace?

source_units.text: They were put to shame because they failed, and even so they were not at all ashamed and did not recognize their dishonor. Therefore they will fall in their fall, and at the time of their visitation they will perish, said the Lord.
source_units.display_text: They were put to shame because they failed, and even so they were not at all ashamed and did not recognize their dishonor. Therefore they will fall in their fall, and at the time of their visitation they will perish, said the Lord.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Stand upon the roads and see, and ask for the Lord’s eternal paths and see which is the good way, and walk in it, and you will find purification for your souls. And they said, ‘We will not go.’
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Stand upon the roads and see, and ask for the Lord’s eternal paths and see which is the good way, and walk in it, and you will find purification for your souls. And they said, ‘We will not go.’

source_units.text: I have appointed watchers over you: Hear the trumpet’s sound! And they said, ‘We will not hear.’
source_units.display_text: I have appointed watchers over you: Hear the trumpet’s sound! And they said, ‘We will not hear.’

source_units.text: Therefore the nations heard, and those shepherding their flocks.
source_units.display_text: Therefore the nations heard, and those shepherding their flocks.

source_units.text: Hear, earth! Behold, I am bringing evils upon this people, the fruit of their turning away, because they did not attend to My words and rejected My law.
source_units.display_text: Hear, earth! Behold, I am bringing evils upon this people, the fruit of their turning away, because they did not attend to My words and rejected My law.

source_units.text: Why do you bring Me frankincense from Sheba and cinnamon from a distant land? Your whole burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices did not please Me.
source_units.display_text: Why do you bring Me frankincense from Sheba and cinnamon from a distant land? Your whole burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices did not please Me.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am placing weakness upon this people, and fathers and sons together will become weak in it; neighbor and his neighbor will perish.
source_units.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am placing weakness upon this people, and fathers and sons together will become weak in it; neighbor and his neighbor will perish.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Behold, a people comes from the north, and nations will be roused from the earth’s extremity.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Behold, a people comes from the north, and nations will be roused from the earth’s extremity.

source_units.text: They will grasp bow and spear; it is ruthless and will show no mercy. Its voice is like a surging sea; on horses and chariots it will draw up like fire for war against you, daughter of Zion.
source_units.display_text: They will grasp bow and spear; it is ruthless and will show no mercy. Its voice is like a surging sea; on horses and chariots it will draw up like fire for war against you, daughter of Zion.

source_units.text: We heard the report of them; our hands were paralyzed. Affliction seized us, labor pains like a woman giving birth.
source_units.display_text: We heard the report of them; our hands were paralyzed. Affliction seized us, labor pains like a woman giving birth.

source_units.text: Do not go out into a field or walk on the roads, because the enemies’ sword dwells all around.
source_units.display_text: Do not go out into a field or walk on the roads, because the enemies’ sword dwells all around.

source_units.text: Daughter of My people, gird yourself with sackcloth; sprinkle yourself with ashes. Make mourning for yourself for a beloved one, a pitiful lament, because misery will suddenly come upon you.
source_units.display_text: Daughter of My people, gird yourself with sackcloth; sprinkle yourself with ashes. Make mourning for yourself for a beloved one, a pitiful lament, because misery will suddenly come upon you.

source_units.text: I have made you a tester among tested peoples, and you will know Me when I test their way.
source_units.display_text: I have made you a tester among tested peoples, and you will know Me when I test their way.

source_units.text: All are unheeding, walking crookedly, bronze and iron; all are corrupted.
source_units.display_text: All are unheeding, walking crookedly, bronze and iron; all are corrupted.

source_units.text: The bellows failed from the fire; the lead failed. In vain the silversmith works silver; their wickedness was not melted away.
source_units.display_text: The bellows failed from the fire; the lead failed. In vain the silversmith works silver; their wickedness was not melted away.

source_units.text: Call them rejected silver, because the Lord rejected them.
source_units.display_text: Call them rejected silver, because the Lord rejected them.

source_units.text: Hear the Lord’s word, all Judea!
source_units.display_text: Hear the Lord’s word, all Judea!

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Correct your ways and your practices, and I will settle you in this place.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Correct your ways and your practices, and I will settle you in this place.

source_units.text: Do not put your confidence in yourselves on false words, because they will not benefit you at all when they say, ‘The Lord’s temple, the Lord’s temple it is.’
source_units.display_text: Do not put your confidence in yourselves on false words, because they will not benefit you at all when they say, ‘The Lord’s temple, the Lord’s temple it is.’

source_units.text: For if you truly correct your ways and practices and truly execute judgment between a man and his neighbor,
source_units.display_text: For if you truly correct your ways and practices and truly execute judgment between a man and his neighbor,

source_units.text: and do not oppress a newcomer, orphan, or widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not follow foreign gods to your own harm,
source_units.display_text: and do not oppress a newcomer, orphan, or widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not follow foreign gods to your own harm,

source_units.text: then I will settle you in this place, in the land I gave your fathers, from age to age.
source_units.display_text: then I will settle you in this place, in the land I gave your fathers, from age to age.

source_units.text: But if you have trusted false words from which you will receive no benefit,
source_units.display_text: But if you have trusted false words from which you will receive no benefit,

source_units.text: and murder and commit adultery and steal and swear unjustly, and you burned incense to Baal and followed foreign gods whom you do not know, to your own harm,
source_units.display_text: and murder and commit adultery and steal and swear unjustly, and you burned incense to Baal and followed foreign gods whom you do not know, to your own harm,

source_units.text: and you came and stood before Me in the house over which My name has been called and said, ‘We have kept away, so as not to do all these abominations,’
source_units.display_text: and you came and stood before Me in the house over which My name has been called and said, ‘We have kept away, so as not to do all these abominations,’

source_units.text: is My house, over which My name has been called there, a robbers’ cave before you? And behold, I have seen, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: is My house, over which My name has been called there, a robbers’ cave before you? And behold, I have seen, says the Lord.

source_units.text: For go to My place in Shiloh, where I formerly made My name dwell, and see what I did to it because of the evil of My people Israel.
source_units.display_text: For go to My place in Shiloh, where I formerly made My name dwell, and see what I did to it because of the evil of My people Israel.

source_units.text: And now, because you did all these works, and I spoke to you and you did not hear Me, and I called you and you did not answer,
source_units.display_text: And now, because you did all these works, and I spoke to you and you did not hear Me, and I called you and you did not answer,

source_units.text: I will also do to this house over which My name has been called, in which you have trusted, and to the place I gave you and your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.
source_units.display_text: I will also do to this house over which My name has been called, in which you have trusted, and to the place I gave you and your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.

source_units.text: And I will throw you away from My presence, as I threw away your brothers, all Ephraim’s offspring.
source_units.display_text: And I will throw you away from My presence, as I threw away your brothers, all Ephraim’s offspring.

source_units.text: And you, do not pray for this people, and do not ask that they receive mercy, and do not pray or approach Me on their behalf, because I will not listen.
source_units.display_text: And you, do not pray for this people, and do not ask that they receive mercy, and do not pray or approach Me on their behalf, because I will not listen.

source_units.text: Do you not see what they are doing in Judah’s cities and Jerusalem’s streets?
source_units.display_text: Do you not see what they are doing in Judah’s cities and Jerusalem’s streets?

source_units.text: Their sons gather wood, and their fathers burn a fire, and their women work dough to make cakes for heaven’s host; and they poured drink offerings to foreign gods to provoke Me to anger.
source_units.display_text: Their sons gather wood, and their fathers burn a fire, and their women work dough to make cakes for heaven’s host; and they poured drink offerings to foreign gods to provoke Me to anger.

source_units.text: Is it Me they provoke to anger? says the Lord. Is it not themselves, so that their faces are put to shame?
source_units.display_text: Is it Me they provoke to anger? says the Lord. Is it not themselves, so that their faces are put to shame?

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, My wrath and fury are poured upon this place, upon the people and the livestock, upon every tree of their field and all the earth’s produce; and it will burn and not be extinguished.
source_units.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, My wrath and fury are poured upon this place, upon the people and the livestock, upon every tree of their field and all the earth’s produce; and it will burn and not be extinguished.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Gather your whole burnt offerings with your sacrifices, and eat meat!
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Gather your whole burnt offerings with your sacrifices, and eat meat!

source_units.text: For I did not speak to your fathers or command them on the day I brought them up from Egypt’s land concerning whole burnt offerings and sacrifice.
source_units.display_text: For I did not speak to your fathers or command them on the day I brought them up from Egypt’s land concerning whole burnt offerings and sacrifice.

source_units.text: But this utterance I commanded them, saying: Hear My voice, and I will be your God and you will be My people; and walk in all My ways that I command you, so that it may be well with you.
source_units.display_text: But this utterance I commanded them, saying: Hear My voice, and I will be your God and you will be My people; and walk in all My ways that I command you, so that it may be well with you.

source_units.text: And they did not hear Me, and their ear did not attend, but they walked in the thoughts of their evil heart and went backward rather than forward.
source_units.display_text: And they did not hear Me, and their ear did not attend, but they walked in the thoughts of their evil heart and went backward rather than forward.

source_units.text: From the day their fathers left Egypt’s land until this day, I sent out to you all My servants the prophets by day and at dawn, and I sent them.
source_units.display_text: From the day their fathers left Egypt’s land until this day, I sent out to you all My servants the prophets by day and at dawn, and I sent them.

source_units.text: And they did not hear Me, and their ear did not attend, and they hardened their neck beyond their fathers.

deferred_source_units.source_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
deferred_source_units.reason: This unit is only the introductory word-coming formula. The particular content of the commission is reviewed in the following units; another generic revelation formula would not provide a sufficiently particular connection for this unit.

deferred_source_units.source_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying, What do you see, Jeremiah? I said, A nut-wood staff.
deferred_source_units.reason: The supplied vision names a nut-wood staff. No verified counterpart establishes the significance of this particular object, and the performance promise in 1:12 does not justify substituting a familiar almond formulation or importing another staff narrative.

deferred_source_units.source_text: Hear the Lord’s word, house of Jacob and every clan of the house of Israel.
deferred_source_units.reason: This unit summons Jacob and every Israelite clan to hear. Its particular indictment follows in 2:5; another broad summons to hear would mainly repeat an introductory form without a further supported connection.

deferred_source_units.source_text: Cross over to the islands of Kittim and see; send to Kedar and consider carefully. See whether such things have happened.
deferred_source_units.reason: The command to inspect Kittim and Kedar introduces the comparison of exchanged gods in 2:11. No particular counterpart for this two-location investigation has been established, and the following supported comparison does not automatically complete this unit.

deferred_source_units.source_text: The sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes knew you and mocked you.
deferred_source_units.reason: The actual verse says the sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes knew and mocked the addressee. A parallel about Egypt shaving or breaking a crown would replace its supplied action; no precise counterpart to this named mockery is retained.

deferred_source_units.source_text: How will you say, I was not polluted and did not follow Baal? See your ways in the burial ground and know what you did. Late her voice wailed; her ways
deferred_source_units.reason: The denial of Baal pollution leads into a burial-ground reference and the unusual connected clause about a late-wailing voice and her ways. Read together with 2:24, these words do not support substituting the familiar camel imagery or assigning a secure particular counterpart to the complete unit.

deferred_source_units.source_text: she broadened upon wilderness waters. In her soul’s desires she was carried by the wind; she was handed over. Who will turn her back? All who seek her will not toil; in her humiliation they will find her.
deferred_source_units.reason: The connected description speaks of broadened ways upon wilderness waters, desire, wind, being handed over and discovery in humiliation. No securely read target clarifies this full combination; familiar wild-donkey or mating-season wording is absent and cannot be substituted.

deferred_source_units.source_text: As a thief is ashamed when caught, so the sons of Israel will be ashamed: they, their kings, their rulers, their priests and their prophets.
deferred_source_units.reason: The particular comparison is shame like that of a caught thief, extended to Israel and its leaders. The read Proverbs thief passage concerns appetite and restitution rather than shame, while the Isaiah shame passage lacks the caught-thief comparison; both candidates remain unretained.

deferred_source_units.source_text: Why do you speak to Me? All of you acted ungodly, and all of you acted lawlessly against Me, says the Lord.
deferred_source_units.reason: The question asks why the people speak to God and then charges everyone with ungodliness and lawlessness. No sufficiently particular counterpart to this question and accusation is established; a generic corporate confession would change the rhetorical situation.

deferred_source_units.source_text: What good practice will you still pursue in your ways to seek love? Not so; you too acted wickedly to pollute your ways.
deferred_source_units.reason: The rhetorical question about pursuing good practice to seek love is followed by polluted ways. The supplied phrasing does not warrant importing a claim that the woman teaches other evil women, and no precise target for its actual question is retained.

deferred_source_units.source_text: Will He remain for ever, or will it be guarded always? Behold, you spoke and did these evil things and were able.
deferred_source_units.reason: The questions ask whether He remains forever or whether it is guarded always, without naming anger as the object. A target about anger not lasting forever would supply an unstated noun; the subsequent charge of effective evil does not resolve that wording sufficiently for a retained pair.

deferred_source_units.source_text: When you multiply and increase upon the land in those days, says the Lord, they will no longer say, The ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel. It will not come to mind, be named or be attended to, and it will not be made again.
deferred_source_units.reason: This unit specifically predicts the ark no longer being recalled, named, attended to or made again. General descriptions of the ark or a new covenant would not themselves establish this particular cessation claim; no verified direct counterpart is retained.

deferred_source_units.source_text: At that time they will say to this people and Jerusalem: A spirit of wandering in the wilderness; the daughter of My people’s way is not toward purity or holiness.
deferred_source_units.reason: The supplied image is a spirit of wandering in the wilderness and a way lacking purity or holiness. No definite counterpart is established, and a familiar hot wind used for winnowing would import absent wording.

deferred_source_units.source_text: A spirit of filling will come to Me; but now I speak judgments against them.
deferred_source_units.reason: The unit speaks of a spirit of filling coming to the speaker while the speaker now announces judgments. Its precise image is unresolved in the supplied text; no target is retained on the basis of an assumed strong-wind reading.

deferred_source_units.source_text: All are strong,
deferred_source_units.reason: The whole unit is All are strong, referring through context to the invading nation. A generic description of another strong army would add little beyond that broad military trait, so the actual short unit remains pending separately from supported 5:15 and 5:17.

deferred_source_units.source_text: Announce these things to the house of Jacob, and let it be heard in Judah.
deferred_source_units.reason: This is an announcement instruction to Jacob and Judah without the subsequent accusation itself. No particular connection beyond the generic two-house address has been retained.

deferred_source_units.reason: This introductory line announces astonishment and horrifying things on the land. The particular corruption is specified in 5:31 and reviewed there; a general horror announcement would not independently substantiate this unit.

deferred_source_units.reason: The actual line says Zion will have her height taken away. No precise counterpart establishes the sense of this height in the siege setting, and familiar descriptions of a beautiful or luxuriant daughter are not present in this unit.

actual_read_units.text: In the beginning God made heaven and earth.
Now the earth was unseen and unformed, and darkness was over the deep; and the Spirit of God was moving over the water.
And God said, “Let there be light.” And there was light.
And God saw that the light was good, and God divided the light from the darkness.
And God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. And there was evening, and there was morning: one day.
And God said, “Let the waters bring forth living creatures that move, and birds that fly above the earth across the firmament of heaven.” And it was so.

And God made the great sea creatures, and every living creature that moves, which the waters brought forth according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that they were good.
And God blessed them, saying, “Grow and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas; and let the birds multiply upon the earth.”
And there was evening, and there was morning: a fifth day.
And God said, “Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kind: four-footed animals, creeping things, and wild beasts of the earth according to their kind.” And it was so.

And God made the wild beasts of the earth according to their kind, and the cattle according to their kind, and all the creeping things of the earth according to their kinds. And God saw that they were good.

And God said, “Let Us make man in Our image and likeness; and let them rule over the fish of the sea, the birds of heaven, the cattle, all the earth, and every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth.”
And God made man; in the image of God He made him; male and female He made them.
